title: Minor wording drift between §3 and §4 for the same remedy family
description: §3 names the safe-substitution remedy as "word-boundary (`\b`), anchored (`^…$`), or scoped (narrow file/path) patterns" while §4 says "word-boundary, anchored, or scoped patterns". Both are correct and refer to the same set; the inconsistency is purely terminological and does not affect MUST compliance.
suggestedFix: Optional: align §4's parenthetical with §3's (`word-boundary (\b), anchored, or scoped (narrow file/path) patterns`) so the two MUST statements use identical vocabulary. Not required for PASS.
